csv_scope_of_work: COUNTY is soliciting proposals from firms who are qualified as a construction manager/general contractor for the performance of Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) services for the New Supplemental Animal Shelter. The intent of this formal Request for Proposal is to receive responses from qualified respondents for awards exempt from competitive solicitation under Nevada Revised Statutes (NRS) 332.115, Revised 2019.

title: CMAR Services for New Supplemental Animal Shelter
short_description: Construction manager at risk services for a new supplemental animal shelter in Las Vegas.
project_scope: New supplemental animal shelter project for Clark County with a stated total construction cost range of 22.2 to 23.3 million USD. The notice does not provide gross floor area, structural system, span lengths, or other technical building characteristics.
services: Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) services as construction manager/general contractor; disciplines requested include Design Build/Developer and Construction/Project Management.
relevance_explanation:
- Animal shelter building with no indication of special structural complexity or long-span elements.
- Procurement is primarily for CMAR/construction management, not structural design services.
- No explicit planning component for structural engineering is described.
- Building type is not among sbp's priority sectors such as bridges, sports, cultural buildings, or special structures.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender documents using the stated total construction cost range of 22.2M to 23.3M USD; midpoint used.
fee_explanation: No explicit design or engineering fee is stated. The notice is for CMAR services, so an sbp structural engineering fee cannot be derived reliably from the available information.
references_qualifications: Firms must be qualified as a construction manager/general contractor for CMAR services. No detailed reference counts or technical qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: County of Clark, Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. Contact: Geraldine Cruz. Phone: 702-455-6277. Fax: 702-455-5883. Email: geraldine.cruz@clarkcountynv.gov. Website: https://clarkcountynv.bonfirehub.com/opportunities/224272
notes: Project number 607856-25; contract number CL-2026-346. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-05-27 09:00 AM PDT via WebEx; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-06-03 05:30 PM PDT. Source lists target market as General Building.
